about: The heading of a reading from the Epistle of Saint Paul to the Galatians. The 1962 Roman Missal prints it over the Epistles of the Sunday within the Octave of the Nativity of the Lord, of the Fourth Sunday of Lent and of the 13th, 14th and 15th Sundays after Pentecost.

s01.translation: A reading from the Epistle of blessed Paul the Apostle to the Galatians
